about_section.title: More than half a century of teaching
about_section.body1: School No. 2 is one of the leading specialized schools in Fergana. The first building opened in 1968, the second in 1989. Today 1,870 students study here.
about_section.body2: We combine strong academic traditions with modern approaches: in-depth study of selected subjects, well-equipped classrooms and highly qualified teachers.

about_page.history_subtitle: Key dates from the school passport.

timeline.title: The Gymnasium
timeline.desc: The historic building served as a gymnasium — first a mens gymnasium, later with preparatory tracks for young men and women.

timeline.title: End of the Imperial era
timeline.desc: After the 1917 October Revolution the Imperial education system collapsed and the gymnasium closed.

timeline.title: Pedagogical Institute
timeline.desc: The building was repurposed for higher education and administrative needs, notably housing the Fergana Pedagogical Institute.

timeline.title: Decision to found the school
timeline.desc: City authorities decided to establish a modern institution to replace the citys older school sites.

timeline.title: School No. 2 opens
timeline.desc: School No. 2 officially opened and welcomed its first students in a new, modern campus.

timeline.title: Second building
timeline.desc: A second teaching building for 270 places was built, raising the schools capacity to 1,150 student places.

timeline.title: Major renovation
timeline.desc: The school buildings were renovated under a state education modernization programme.

timeline.title: Today
timeline.desc: Today School No. 2 has 1,870 students in 57 classes, with in-depth study of selected subjects.

about_page.mission_body: To equip every student with deep knowledge, creative thinking and civic responsibility.
about_page.vision_body: To become a model school of Uzbekistan, raising the leaders of tomorrow.
about_page.values_body: Integrity, a drive for knowledge, respect for culture and openness to the world.
